entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, I heard the scam group that[n]was going after old people has[n]changed their ways.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Apparently the leader even[n]called the victims personally[n]to apologize.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I can't believe people treat you[n]so poorly when you're going out of[n]your way to help others like this!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Well, I for one want to[n]strive to change that world.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway, I'll be counting on you in[n]the future too. I'm on your side!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We managed to meet people's[n]expectations this time too![n]I'm so proud of us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think we may just solve the mystery[n]of Mementos soon... I'm starting to[n]get anxious...
